## How it works

<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Use BCF visibility to share a focused coordination view. The presets demonstrate hiding doors and windows, showing only doors and windows, hiding spaces/boundaries/openings, and showing spaces alone. With <code>DefaultVisibility=true</code>, exceptions are hidden; with <code>false</code>, exceptions are shown. Setup hints separately control space volumes and openings. Apply the saved state with <code>bcf.save()</code>, <code>viewer.add()</code> and <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code>.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<p>Component groups and project identifiers are queried from source bytes through the native <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>. Colors, camera poses and cutting planes are authored BCF inputs.</p><p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
